title: Banks Act Directive D9/2013 — Investments, and loans and advances by controlling companies: section 50 of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Investments, and loans and advances by controlling companies: section 50 of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990).

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Investments, and loans and advances by controlling companies: section 50 of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990).

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Investments, and loans and advances by controlling companies: section 50 of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
